versos.grego: Καὶ ὅτε ἤγγισαν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα καὶ ἦλθον εἰς Βηθφαγὴ εἰς τὸ ὄρος τῶν Ἐλαιῶν, τότε Ἰησοῦς ἀπέστειλεν δύο μαθητὰς

controles.web: When they drew near to Jerusalem, and came to Bethsphage, to the Mount of Olives, then Jesus sent two disciples,
controles.kjv: And when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem, and were come to Bethphage, unto the mount of Olives, then sent Jesus two disciples,
controles.livre: E quando se aproximaram de Jerusalém, e chegaram a Betfagé, ao monte das Oliveiras, então Jesus mandou dois discípulos, dizendo-lhes:

versos.grego: λέγων αὐτοῖς Πορεύεσθε εἰς τὴν κώμην τὴν κατέναντι ὑμῶν, καὶ εὐθὺς εὑρήσετε ὄνον δεδεμένην καὶ πῶλον μετ’ αὐτῆς· λύσαντες ἀγάγετέ μοι.

controles.web: saying to them, “Go into the village that is opposite you, and immediately you will find a donkey tied, and a colt with her. Untie them, and bring them to me.
controles.kjv: Saying unto them, Go into the village over against you, and straightway ye shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her: loose them, and bring them unto me.
controles.livre: Ide à aldeia em vossa frente, e logo achareis uma jumenta amarrada, e um jumentinho com ela; desamarra-a, e trazei-os a mim.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐάν τις ὑμῖν εἴπῃ τι, ἐρεῖτε ὅτι Ὁ Κύριος αὐτῶν χρείαν ἔχει· εὐθὺς δὲ ἀποστελεῖ αὐτούς.

controles.web: If anyone says anything to you, you shall say, ‘The Lord needs them,’ and immediately he will send them.”
controles.kjv: And if any man say ought unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.
controles.livre: E se alguém vos disser algo, direis: “O Senhor precisa deles, mas logo os devolverá”.

versos.grego: Τοῦτο δὲ γέγονεν ἵνα πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος

controles.web: All this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying,
controles.kjv: All this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying,
controles.livre: Ora, isto aconteceu para que se cumprisse o que foi dito pelo profeta, que disse:

versos.grego: Εἴπατε τῇ θυγατρὶ Σιών Ἰδοὺ ὁ Βασιλεύς σου ἔρχεταί σοι πραῢς καὶ ἐπιβεβηκὼς ἐπὶ ὄνον καὶ ἐπὶ πῶλον υἱὸν ὑποζυγίου.

controles.web: “Tell the daughter of Zion, behold, your King comes to you, humble, and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.”
controles.kjv: Tell ye the daughter of Sion, Behold, thy King cometh unto thee, meek, and sitting upon an ass, and a colt the foal of an ass.
controles.livre: Dizei à filha de Sião: “Eis que o teu rei vem a ti, manso,  e sentado sobre um jumento; um jumentinho, filho de uma animal de carga”.

versos.grego: πορευθέντες δὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ καὶ ποιήσαντες καθὼς συνέταξεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς

controles.web: The disciples went, and did just as Jesus commanded them,
controles.kjv: And the disciples went, and did as Jesus commanded them,
controles.livre: Os discípulos foram, e fizeram como Jesus havia lhes mandado;

versos.grego: ἤγαγον τὴν ὄνον καὶ τὸν πῶλον, καὶ ἐπέθηκαν ἐπ’ αὐτῶν τὰ ἱμάτια, καὶ ἐπεκάθισεν ἐπάνω αὐτῶν.

controles.web: and brought the donkey and the colt, and laid their clothes on them; and he sat on them.
controles.kjv: And brought the ass, and the colt, and put on them their clothes, and they set him thereon.
controles.livre: Então trouxeram a jumenta e o jumentinho, puseram as capas sobre eles, e ele montou sobre elas.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ πλεῖστος ὄχλος ἔστρωσαν ἑαυτῶν τὰ ἱμάτια ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ, ἄλλοι δὲ ἔκοπτον κλάδους ἀπὸ τῶν δένδρων καὶ ἐστρώννυον ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ.

controles.web: A very great multitude spread their clothes on the road. Others cut branches from the trees, and spread them on the road.
controles.kjv: And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way; others cut down branches from the trees, and strawed them in the way.
controles.livre: E uma grande multidão estendia suas roupas pelo caminho, e outros cortavam ramos das árvores, e os espalhavam pelo caminho.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ ὄχλοι οἱ προάγοντες αὐτὸν καὶ οἱ ἀκολουθοῦντες ἔκραζον λέγοντες Ὡσαννὰ τῷ υἱῷ Δαυείδ· Εὐλογημένος ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἐν ὀνόματι Κυρίου· Ὡσαννὰ ἐν τοῖς ὑψίστοις.

controles.web: The multitudes who went before him, and who followed kept shouting, “Hosanna  to the son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”
controles.kjv: And the multitudes that went before, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the Son of David: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.
controles.livre: E as multidões que iam adiante dele, e as que seguiam, clamavam: Hosana ao Filho de Davi! Bendito o que vem no nome do Senhor! Hosana nas alturas!

versos.grego: καὶ εἰσελθόντος αὐτοῦ εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα ἐσείσθη πᾶσα ἡ πόλις λέγουσα Τίς ἐστιν οὗτος;

controles.web: When he had come into Jerusalem, all the city was stirred up, saying, “Who is this?”
controles.kjv: And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this?
controles.livre: Enquanto ele entrava em Jerusalém, toda a cidade se alvoroçou, perguntando: Quem é este?

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ ὄχλοι ἔλεγον Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ προφήτης Ἰησοῦς ὁ ἀπὸ Ναζαρὲθ τῆς Γαλιλαίας.

controles.web: The multitudes said, “This is the prophet, Jesus, from Nazareth of Galilee.”
controles.kjv: And the multitude said, This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee.
controles.livre: E as multidões respondiam: Este é o Profeta Jesus, de Nazaré de Galileia.

versos.grego: Καὶ εἰσῆλθεν Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὸ ἱερόν καὶ ἐξέβαλεν πάντας τοὺς πωλοῦντας καὶ ἀγοράζοντας ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ καὶ τὰς τραπέζας τῶν κολλυβιστῶν κατέστρεψεν καὶ τὰς καθέδρας τῶν πωλούντων τὰς περιστεράς,

controles.web: Jesus entered into the temple of God, and drove out all of those who sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.
controles.kjv: And Jesus went into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves,
controles.livre: Jesus entrou no Templo; então expulsou todos os que estavam vendendo e comprando no Templo, e virou as mesas dos cambistas e as cadeiras dos que vendiam pombas.

versos.grego: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Γέγραπται Ὁ οἶκός μου οἶκος προσευχῆς κληθήσεται, ὑμεῖς δὲ αὐτὸν ποιεῖτε σπήλαιον λῃστῶν.

controles.web: He said to them, “It is written, ‘My house shall be called a house of prayer,’but you have made it a den of robbers!”
controles.kjv: And said unto them, It is written, My house shall be called the house of prayer; but ye have made it a den of thieves.
controles.livre: E disse-lhes: Está escrito: “Minha casa será chamada casa de oração”; mas vós a tornais em covil de ladrões!

versos.grego: Καὶ προσῆλθον αὐτῷ τυφλοὶ καὶ χωλοὶ ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ, καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν αὐτούς.

controles.web: The blind and the lame came to him in the temple, and he healed them.
controles.kjv: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple; and he healed them.
controles.livre: E cegos e mancos vieram a ele no Templo, e ele os curou.

versos.grego: ἰδόντες δὲ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς τὰ θαυμάσια ἃ ἐποίησεν καὶ τοὺς παῖδας τοὺς κράζοντας ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ καὶ λέγοντας Ὡσαννὰ τῷ υἱῷ Δαυείδ, ἠγανάκτησαν,

controles.web: But when the chief priests and the scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children who were crying in the temple and saying, “Hosanna to the son of David!” they were indignant,
controles.kjv: And when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children crying in the temple, and saying, Hosanna to the Son of David; they were sore displeased,
controles.livre: Quando os chefes dos sacerdotes e os escribas viram as maravilhas que ele fazia, e as crianças gritando no Templo: “Hosana ao Filho de Davi!”, eles ficaram indignados.

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ Ἀκούεις τί οὗτοι λέγουσιν; ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς λέγει αὐτοῖς Ναί· οὐδέποτε ἀνέγνωτε ὅτι Ἐκ στόματος νηπίων καὶ θηλαζόντων κατηρτίσω αἶνον;

controles.web: and said to him, “Do you hear what these are saying?”   Jesus said to them, “Yes. Did you never read, ‘Out of the mouth of babes and nursing babies you have perfected praise?’”
controles.kjv: And said unto him, Hearest thou what these say? And Jesus saith unto them, Yea; have ye never read, Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise?
controles.livre: E perguntaram-lhe: Ouves o que estas crianças dizem?E Jesus lhes respondeu: Sim. Nunca lestes: “Da boca das crianças e dos bebês  providenciaste o louvor?”

versos.grego: Καὶ καταλιπὼν αὐτοὺς ἐξῆλθεν ἔξω τῆς πόλεως εἰς Βηθανίαν, καὶ ηὐλίσθη ἐκεῖ.

controles.web: He left them, and went out of the city to Bethany, and lodged there.
controles.kjv: And he left them, and went out of the city into Bethany; and he lodged there.
controles.livre: Então ele os deixou, e saiu da cidade para Betânia, e ali passou a noite.

versos.grego: Πρωῒ δὲ ἐπαναγαγὼν εἰς τὴν πόλιν ἐπείνασεν.

controles.web: Now in the morning, as he returned to the city, he was hungry.
controles.kjv: Now in the morning as he returned into the city, he hungered.
controles.livre: E pela manhã, enquanto voltava para a cidade, teve fome.

versos.grego: καὶ ἰδὼν συκῆν μίαν ἐπὶ τῆς ὁδοῦ ἦλθεν ἐπ’ αὐτήν, καὶ οὐδὲν εὗρεν ἐν αὐτῇ εἰ μὴ φύλλα μόνον, καὶ λέγει αὐτῇ Οὐ μηκέτι ἐκ σοῦ καρπὸς γένηται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα. καὶ ἐξηράνθη παραχρῆμα ἡ συκῆ.

controles.web: Seeing a fig tree by the road, he came to it, and found nothing on it but leaves. He said to it, “Let there be no fruit from you forever!”    Immediately the fig tree withered away.
controles.kjv: And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only, and said unto it, Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away.
controles.livre: Quando ele viu uma figueira perto do caminho, veio a ela, mas nada nela achou, a não ser somente folhas. E disse-lhe: Nunca de ti nasça fruto, jamais!E imediatamente a figueira se secou.

versos.grego: καὶ ἰδόντες οἱ μαθηταὶ ἐθαύμασαν λέγοντες Πῶς παραχρῆμα ἐξηράνθη ἡ συκῆ;

controles.web: When the disciples saw it, they marveled, saying, “How did the fig tree immediately wither away?”
controles.kjv: And when the disciples saw it, they marvelled, saying, How soon is the fig tree withered away!
controles.livre: Os discípulos viram, e ficaram maravilhados, dizendo: Como a figueira se secou de imediato?

versos.grego: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐὰν ἔχητε πίστιν καὶ μὴ διακριθῆτε, οὐ μόνον τὸ τῆς συκῆς ποιήσετε, ἀλλὰ κἂν τῷ ὄρει τούτῳ εἴπητε Ἄρθητι καὶ βλήθητι εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν, γενήσεται·

controles.web: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, if you have faith, and don’t doubt, you will not only do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you told this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ it would be done.
controles.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, If ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do this which is done to the fig tree, but also if ye shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; it shall be done.
controles.livre: Porém Jesus lhes respondeu: Em verdade vos digo: se tiverdes fé, e não duvidardes, vós não somente fareis isto à figueira, mas até se disserdes a este monte: “Levanta-te, e lança-te no mar”, isso se fará.

versos.grego: καὶ πάντα ὅσα ἂν αἰτήσητε ἐν τῇ προσευχῇ πιστεύοντες λήμψεσθε.

controles.web: All things, whatever you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive.”
controles.kjv: And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.
controles.livre: E tudo o que pedirdes em oração, crendo, recebereis.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἐλθόντος αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν προσῆλθον αὐτῷ διδάσκοντι οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι τοῦ λαοῦ λέγοντες Ἐν ποίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ ταῦτα ποιεῖς; καὶ τίς σοι ἔδωκεν τὴν ἐξουσίαν ταύτην;

controles.web: When he had come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him as he was teaching, and said, “By what authority do you do these things? Who gave you this authority?”
controles.kjv: And when he was come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority?
controles.livre: Depois de entrar no templo, quando ele estava ensinando, os chefes dos sacerdotes e os anciãos do povo se aproximaram dele, perguntando: Com que autoridade fazes isto? E quem te deu esta autoridade?

versos.grego: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἐρωτήσω ὑμᾶς κἀγὼ λόγον ἕνα, ὃν ἐὰν εἴπητέ μοι, κἀγὼ ὑμῖν ἐρῶ ἐν ποίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ ταῦτα ποιῶ·

controles.web: Jesus answered them, “I also will ask you one question, which if you tell me, I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things.
controles.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I also will ask you one thing, which if ye tell me, I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things.
controles.livre: Jesus lhes respondeu: Eu também vos farei uma pergunta. Se vós a responderdes a mim, também eu vos responderei com que autoridade faço isto.

versos.grego: τὸ βάπτισμα τὸ Ἰωάνου πόθεν ἦν; ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ἢ ἐξ ἀνθρώπων; οἱ δὲ διελογίζοντο ἐν ἑαυτοῖς λέγοντες· Ἐὰν εἴπωμεν Ἐξ οὐρανοῦ, ἐρεῖ ἡμῖν Διὰ τί οὖν οὐκ ἐπιστεύσατε αὐτῷ;

controles.web: The baptism of John, where was it from? From heaven or from men?”    They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask us, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
controles.kjv: The baptism of John, whence was it? from heaven, or of men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say unto us, Why did ye not then believe him?
controles.livre: De onde era o batismo de João? Do céu, ou dos seres humanos?E eles pensaram entre si mesmos, dizendo: Se dissermos: “Do céu”, ele nos dirá: “Por que, então, não crestes nele?

versos.grego: ἐὰν δὲ εἴπωμεν Ἐξ ἀνθρώπων, φοβούμεθα τὸν ὄχλον· πάντες γὰρ ὡς προφήτην ἔχουσιν τὸν Ἰωάνην.

controles.web: But if we say, ‘From men,’ we fear the multitude, for all hold John as a prophet.”
controles.kjv: But if we shall say, Of men; we fear the people; for all hold John as a prophet.
controles.livre: Mas se dissermos: “Dos seres humanos”, temos medo da multidão, pois todos consideram João como profeta.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀποκριθέντες τῷ Ἰησοῦ εἶπαν Οὐκ οἴδαμεν. ἔφη αὐτοῖς καὶ αὐτός Οὐδὲ ἐγὼ λέγω ὑμῖν ἐν ποίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ ταῦτα ποιῶ.

controles.web: They answered Jesus, and said, “We don’t know.”   He also said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.
controles.kjv: And they answered Jesus, and said, We cannot tell. And he said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
controles.livre: Então responderam a Jesus: Não sabemos. E ele lhes disse: Nem eu vos digo com que autoridade faço isto.

versos.grego: Τί δὲ ὑμῖν δοκεῖ; ἄνθρωπος εἶχεν τέκνα δύο· προσελθὼν τῷ πρώτῳ εἶπεν Τέκνον, ὕπαγε σήμερον ἐργάζου ἐν τῷ ἀμπελῶνι.

controles.web: But what do you think? A man had two sons, and he came to the first, and said, ‘Son, go work today in my vineyard.’
controles.kjv: But what think ye? A certain man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to day in my vineyard.
controles.livre: Mas que vos parece? Um homem tinha dois filhos. Aproximando-se do primeiro, disse: “Filho, vai hoje trabalhar na minha vinha.”

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν Ἐγὼ κύριε, καὶ οὐκ ἀπῆλθεν.

controles.web: He answered, ‘I will not,’ but afterward he changed his mind, and went.
controles.kjv: He answered and said, I will not: but afterward he repented, and went.
controles.livre: Porém ele respondeu: “Eu vou ,senhor”, mas não foi.

versos.grego: προσελθὼν δὲ τῷ δευτέρῳ εἶπεν ὡσαύτως. ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν Οὐ θέλω, ὕστερον μεταμεληθεὶς ἀπῆλθεν.

controles.web: He came to the second, and said the same thing. He answered, ‘I go, sir,’ but he didn’t go.
controles.kjv: And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I go, sir: and went not.
controles.livre: E, aproximando-se do segundo, disse da mesma maneira. E ele respondeu: “Não quero”; mas depois se arrependeu, e foi.

versos.grego: τίς ἐκ τῶν δύο ἐποίησεν τὸ θέλημα τοῦ πατρός; λέγουσιν Ὁ ὕστερος. λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι οἱ τελῶναι καὶ αἱ πόρναι προάγουσιν ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: Which of the two did the will of his father?”   They said to him, “The first.”   Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering into the Kingdom of God before you.
controles.kjv: Whether of them twain did the will of his father? They say unto him, The first. Jesus saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.
controles.livre: Qual dos dois fez a vontade do pai?Eles lhe responderam: O segundo.  Jesus lhes disse: Em verdade vos digo que os cobradores de impostos e as prostitutas estão indo adiante de vós ao Reino de Deus.

versos.grego: ἦλθεν γὰρ Ἰωάνης πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐν ὁδῷ δικαιοσύνης, καὶ οὐκ ἐπιστεύσατε αὐτῷ· οἱ δὲ τελῶναι καὶ αἱ πόρναι ἐπίστευσαν αὐτῷ· ὑμεῖς δὲ ἰδόντες οὐδὲ μετεμελήθητε ὕστερον τοῦ πιστεῦσαι αὐτῷ.

controles.web: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you didn’t believe him, but the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him. When you saw it, you didn’t even repent afterward, that you might believe him.
controles.kjv: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not: but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and ye, when ye had seen it, repented not afterward, that ye might believe him.
controles.livre: Pois João veio a vós mesmos no caminho de justiça, mas não crestes nele; enquanto que os cobradores de impostos e as prostitutas nele creram. Vós, porém, mesmo tendo visto isto ,nem assim vos arrependestes, a fim de nele crer.

versos.grego: Ἄλλην παραβολὴν ἀκούσατε. Ἄνθρωπος ἦν οἰκοδεσπότης ὅστις ἐφύτευσεν ἀμπελῶνα, καὶ φραγμὸν αὐτῷ περιέθηκεν καὶ ὤρυξεν ἐν αὐτῷ ληνὸν καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν πύργον, καὶ ἐξέδετο αὐτὸν γεωργοῖς, καὶ ἀπεδήμησεν.

controles.web: “Hear another parable. There was a man who was a master of a household, who planted a vineyard, set a hedge about it, dug a wine press in it, built a tower, leased it out to farmers, and went into another country.
controles.kjv: Hear another parable: There was a certain householder, which planted a vineyard, and hedged it round about, and digged a winepress in it, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country:
controles.livre: Ouvi outra parábola. Havia um homem, dono de uma propriedade. Ele plantou uma vinha, cercou- a, fundou nela um lagar, e construiu uma torre. Depois a arrendou a uns lavradores, e partiu-se para um lugar distante.

versos.grego: ὅτε δὲ ἤγγισεν ὁ καιρὸς τῶν καρπῶν, ἀπέστειλεν τοὺς δούλους αὐτοῦ πρὸς τοὺς γεωργοὺς λαβεῖν τοὺς καρποὺς αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: When the season for the fruit drew near, he sent his servants to the farmers, to receive his fruit.
controles.kjv: And when the time of the fruit drew near, he sent his servants to the husbandmen, that they might receive the fruits of it.
controles.livre: Quando chegou o tempo dos frutos, enviou seus servos aos lavradores, para receberem os frutos que a ele pertenciam.

versos.grego: καὶ λαβόντες οἱ γεωργοὶ τοὺς δούλους αὐτοῦ ὃν μὲν ἔδειραν, ὃν δὲ ἀπέκτειναν, ὃν δὲ ἐλιθοβόλησαν.

controles.web: The farmers took his servants, beat one, killed another, and stoned another.
controles.kjv: And the husbandmen took his servants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.
controles.livre: Mas os lavradores tomaram os seus servos, e feriram um, mataram outro, e apedrejaram outro.

versos.grego: πάλιν ἀπέστειλεν ἄλλους δούλους πλείονας τῶν πρώτων, καὶ ἐποίησαν αὐτοῖς ὡσαύτως.

controles.web: Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they treated them the same way.
controles.kjv: Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they did unto them likewise.
controles.livre: Outra vez enviou outros servos, em maior número que os primeiros, mas fizeram-lhes o mesmo.

versos.grego: ὕστερον δὲ ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ λέγων Ἐντραπήσονται τὸν υἱόν μου.

controles.web: But afterward he sent to them his son, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
controles.kjv: But last of all he sent unto them his son, saying, They will reverence my son.
controles.livre: E por último lhes enviou o seu filho, dizendo: “Respeitarão ao meu filho”.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ γεωργοὶ ἰδόντες τὸν υἱὸν εἶπον ἐν ἑαυτοῖς Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ κληρονόμος· δεῦτε ἀποκτείνωμεν αὐτὸν καὶ σχῶμεν τὴν κληρονομίαν αὐτοῦ·

controles.web: But the farmers, when they saw the son, said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, and seize his inheritance.’
controles.kjv: But when the husbandmen saw the son, they said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and let us seize on his inheritance.
controles.livre: Mas quando os lavradores viram o filho, disseram entre si: “Este é o herdeiro. Venhamos matá-lo, e tomemos a sua herança”.

versos.grego: καὶ λαβόντες αὐτὸν ἐξέβαλον ἔξω τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος καὶ ἀπέκτειναν.

controles.web: So they took him, and threw him out of the vineyard, and killed him.
controles.kjv: And they caught him, and cast him out of the vineyard, and slew him.
controles.livre: Então o agarraram, lançaram-no para fora da vinha, e o mataram.

versos.grego: ὅταν οὖν ἔλθῃ ὁ κύριος τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος, τί ποιήσει τοῖς γεωργοῖς ἐκείνοις;

controles.web: When therefore the lord of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those farmers?”
controles.kjv: When the lord therefore of the vineyard cometh, what will he do unto those husbandmen?
controles.livre: Ora, quando o senhor da vinha chegar, o que fará com aqueles lavradores?

versos.grego: λέγουσιν αὐτῷ Κακοὺς κακῶς ἀπολέσει αὐτούς, καὶ τὸν ἀμπελῶνα ἐκδώσεται ἄλλοις γεωργοῖς, οἵτινες ἀποδώσουσιν αὐτῷ τοὺς καρποὺς ἐν τοῖς καιροῖς αὐτῶν.

controles.web: They told him, “He will miserably destroy those miserable men, and will lease out the vineyard to other farmers, who will give him the fruit in its season.”
controles.kjv: They say unto him, He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen, which shall render him the fruits in their seasons.
controles.livre: Eles lhe responderam: Aos maus dará uma morte má, e arrendará a vinha a outros lavradores, que lhe deem os frutos em seus tempos de colheita .

versos.grego: Λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Οὐδέποτε ἀνέγνωτε ἐν ταῖς γραφαῖς Λίθον ὃν ἀπεδοκίμασαν οἱ οἰκοδομοῦντες, οὗτος ἐγενήθη εἰς κεφαλὴν γωνίας· παρὰ Κυρίου ἐγένετο αὕτη, καὶ ἔστιν θαυμαστὴ ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς ἡμῶν;

controles.web: Jesus said to them, “Did you never read in the Scriptures,   ‘The stone which the builders rejected, the same was made the head of the corner. This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes?’
controles.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Did ye never read in the scriptures, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner: this is the Lord’s doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
controles.livre: Jesus lhes disse: Nunca lestes nas Escrituras: “A pedra que os construtores rejeitaram, essa se tornou cabeça da esquina. Isto foi feito pelo Senhor, e é maravilhoso aos nossos olhos”?

versos.grego: διὰ τοῦτο λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἀρθήσεται ἀφ’ ὑμῶν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ δοθήσεται ἔθνει ποιοῦντι τοὺς καρποὺς αὐτῆς.

controles.web: “Therefore I tell you, the Kingdom of God will be taken away from you, and will be given to a nation producing its fruit.
controles.kjv: Therefore say I unto you, The kingdom of God shall be taken from you, and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof.
controles.livre: Portanto eu vos digo que o reino de Deus será tirado de vós, e será dado a um povo que produza os frutos dele.

versos.grego: καὶ ὁ πεσὼν ἐπὶ τὸν λίθον τοῦτον συνθλασθήσεται· ἐφ’ ὃν δ’ ἂν πέσῃ, λικμήσει αὐτόν.

controles.web: He who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but on whomever it will fall, it will scatter him as dust.”
controles.kjv: And whosoever shall fall on this stone shall be broken: but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.
controles.livre: E quem cair sobre esta pedra será quebrado; mas sobre quem ela cair, ela o tornará em pó.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἀκούσαντες οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι τὰς παραβολὰς αὐτοῦ ἔγνωσαν ὅτι περὶ αὐτῶν λέγει·

controles.web: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his parables, they perceived that he spoke about them.
controles.kjv: And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables, they perceived that he spake of them.
controles.livre: Quando os chefes dos sacerdotes e os fariseus ouviram estas suas parábolas, entenderam que Jesus estava falando deles.

versos.grego: καὶ ζητοῦντες αὐτὸν κρατῆσαι ἐφοβήθησαν τοὺς ὄχλους, ἐπεὶ εἰς προφήτην αὐτὸν εἶχον.

controles.web: When they sought to seize him, they feared the multitudes, because they considered him to be a prophet.
controles.kjv: But when they sought to lay hands on him, they feared the multitude, because they took him for a prophet.
controles.livre: E procuravam prendê-lo, mas temeram as multidões, pois elas o consideravam profeta.
